_meta.description: Tenders and contract packages for Line 7A. Values in crore INR. 'tender_status' is floated, bids_opened, awarded, cancelled or unknown. Only packages whose source was read are listed; the telecom (Efkon), radio and fare collection (LTTS) contracts for Lines 9 and 7A, and the signalling, wait for a source read in full.

tenders.scope: Viaduct, ramp, bored tunnels and both stations of 7A
Diversion of the 1,800 mm sewer line crossing the 7A alignment near the airport
tenders.notes: MMRDA tender notice, 2 Dec 2021 (closing 5 Jan 2022). No award was found.

tenders.scope: Consultant to obtain the coastal zone (CRZ) clearance and update the environmental report of Lines 9 and 7A
tenders.notes: MMRDA notice, 28 Sep 2022 (closing 5 Oct 2022). No award was found.

tenders.scope: Power: 33 kV and 25 kV cabling, overhead wire with switching station, auxiliary power, SCADA, for Lines 9 and 7A
tenders.notes: Lowest bid Rs 122.09 crore (13.03% above the estimate), against Siemens at Rs 185.35 crore; award reported in a June 2025 update, value not given. Metro Rail Today reports about Rs 118.2 crore at the letter of acceptance. Shared with Line 9.
